from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class Paper(BaseModel):
    """One document from the collection: its own title and references to other provided papers."""
    title: str | None = Field(description="The title of this paper as found in the text")
    references_provided_papers: list[str] = Field(description="Titles of OTHER provided papers (from the known collection) that this paper cites in its bibliography")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    """Result of parsing a single document."""
    papers: list[Paper]
